validation.scheme: subject-wise 5-fold, stratified by health group; folds generated on all 70 subjects before optional HC43 exclusion

normalization.mode: transductive subject normalization; no labels are used
normalization.training_statistics: per subject and feature using all training segments for that subject, including validation-fold segments
normalization.public_statistics: per user and feature computed independently over that user's 8 trials

metrics.secondary: binary F1 for positive emotion, balanced accuracy
metrics.diagnostics: per-fold, per-subject and health-group pooled and subject-macro results
